$schema_note: C-authored, independent of B runner code. Values are derived only from SSOTV3 04_FLOW_CODEBOOK §2-§5, 03_COLLECTION_MEASUREMENT_SPEC §5-§9, 00_SSOT §6-§7, 02_DATA_SCHEMA §4-§5 and from the fixture geometry C built.

derivation_rules_preregistered.task_flow_sequence: experienced_flow_sequence with every DISMISS_OBSTRUCTION removed; order preserved; terminal token (ENDPOINT_REACHED|AUTH_GATE) kept as last element (codebook §3 example keeps AUTH_GATE).
derivation_rules_preregistered.activation_depth: count of tokens in ACTIVATION_SET, where the three CONDITIONAL tokens (SELECT_ORIGIN/SELECT_DESTINATION/SELECT_DATE) count only when the observation's fixture_input_mode for that token is a control means (DROPDOWN/MAP_PAN/PICKER/CALENDAR → IN); FREE_TEXT typing → OUT (flow_step_count only); MIXED → the means actually used; missing/OTHER → UNRESOLVED (counted OUT, flagged). A T-A-V3-STEP1-006 CONDITIONAL rule; Δ8-R5 fixture_input_mode is recorded by the collector from what the SERVICE offers (service-first: the collector does not choose the means). SUBMIT_QUERY IS counted (button activation; 03 §6 exclusion list names only scroll, passive load, per-character typing, popup dismiss). INPUT_QUERY, DISMISS_OBSTRUCTION, AUTH_GATE, ENDPOINT_REACHED are not. Same rule as lane6 c_flow_derive.py::resolve_input_mode.
derivation_rules_preregistered.flow_step_count: count of task_flow_sequence tokens excluding the pure terminal markers ENDPOINT_REACHED and ABSTAIN; AUTH_GATE IS counted (04 §5 'auth encounter 포함'; A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-03 confirms: ENDPOINT_REACHED and ABSTAIN excluded, AUTH_GATE included). Typing/submit counted. Scroll/dismiss never counted.
derivation_rules_preregistered.menu_dependency: true iff any REVEAL_SET token precedes the terminal token (sequence-based; A T-A-V3-STEP1-011 P-09: 04 §4/§5 wording wins over 10_GLOSSARY, nav_container_depth and s0_task_control_visible carry the 'task control not directly visible' concept). SWITCH_TAB is NOT a reveal token (A T-A-V3-STEP1-011 P-06; it stays in ACTIVATION_SET per STEP1-006); menu_dependency_incl_tab is the declared sensitivity.
derivation_rules_preregistered.nav_container_depth: count of REVEAL_SET tokens that precede the anchor = the first SELECT_FUNCTION or, when absent, the first task-body token (INPUT_QUERY / SELECT_CATEGORY / SELECT_ORIGIN / SELECT_DESTINATION / SELECT_DATE / SUBMIT_QUERY / SELECT_RESULT / OPEN_ITEM_DETAIL / OPEN_PLACE_DETAIL); no anchor → count reveals before the terminal and flag nav_anchor_found=false (C-DECISION_REQUEST-031138 P-11, lane6 C-5 rule adopted). SELECT_CATEGORY navigating to a category page is a page transition, not a container reveal, so it adds no depth (fixture 1: depth 1, not 2 — unchanged under the anchor rule because the reveal precedes SELECT_CATEGORY as well).
derivation_rules_preregistered.forced_dismissal_count: count of DISMISS_OBSTRUCTION in experienced_flow_sequence; each must be paired with a fact_task_obstruction row with dismiss_required_for_task=true.
derivation_rules_preregistered.dismiss_required_for_task: true iff the next frozen-path control is not hittable (hit-test at its center lands on the interrupt) until an allowed close control is activated. Geometric overlap alone is insufficient; a blocking_proof click must fail. Primary across C lanes per C-DECISION_REQUEST-031138 P-24 (lane7 aligned: aria-modal / occlusion>0 are dismiss_required_signal, never the verdict).
derivation_rules_preregistered.task_control_occlusion: fraction of a uniform 9x9 sample grid inside the next-path-control bbox whose elementFromPoint is neither the control nor its descendant (hit-test); cross-checked with bbox-intersection against [data-c-overlay] elements. Measured against the path-entry control of the CURRENT state (hamburger at S0 when the task function is behind a menu). Null convention (A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-04): null = not observed (control outside the viewport / no path control at S0); 0.0 = observed and unoccluded. Primary across C lanes per C-DECISION_REQUEST-031138 P-23 (lane7 aligned: geometry on the frozen entry control is occlusion_geom_crosscheck). Geometric cross-check = area of the UNION of all [data-c-overlay] bbox ∩ control bbox over the control area (union, so two overlays that together cover the control are not under-counted; identical to the single-overlay value on fixtures 1-8). overlay_coverage is likewise the union of overlay bboxes over the viewport.
derivation_rules_preregistered.overlay_coverage: secondary only: overlay bbox area / viewport area. Non-zero coverage with occlusion 0 is NOT an obstruction (fixture 3).
derivation_rules_preregistered.s0_task_control_visible: true iff the SELECT_FUNCTION control's bbox intersects the S0 viewport AND it is hit-testable at S0 (elementFromPoint at its centre is the control or a descendant). No occlusion threshold — independent of task_control_occlusion (A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-05). A hamburger that leads to it does not count. Positive control occluded_but_hittable: occlusion ≈0.84 with the centre hit-testable → true; a runner applying an occlusion threshold (e.g. <0.5) fails it.
derivation_rules_preregistered.first_visible_scroll_state: the scroll state Sk (scroll step chosen by runner within [120,844] px) at which the SELECT_FUNCTION control was FIRST observed; for a control exposed by a reveal it is the scroll state where the reveal happened (S0 in the menu-hidden fixtures); null ONLY when the control was never observed on the path (login wall), and then endpoint_status × terminal_reason carry the reason (A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-02).

auth_gate_stage.authority: A T-A-V3-STEP1-011 P-13/P-14 (single positional rule; supersedes C's r1 wording, fixture values unchanged)
auth_gate_stage.NONE: no AUTH_GATE token (observed to a non-auth terminal with evidence; otherwise UNDETERMINED per R13).
auth_gate_stage.BEFORE_TASK_DISCOVERY: no task-specific token precedes AUTH_GATE — only general navigation (OPEN_GLOBAL_MENU / OPEN_LOCAL_MENU / SWITCH_TAB / EXPAND_ACCORDION / DISMISS_OBSTRUCTION) or nothing at all. OPEN_GLOBAL_MENU > AUTH_GATE → BEFORE_TASK_DISCOVERY.
auth_gate_stage.AFTER_TASK_SELECT: at least one task-specific token precedes AUTH_GATE but the endpoint contract is not yet satisfied. OPEN_GLOBAL_MENU > SELECT_CATEGORY > AUTH_GATE → AFTER_TASK_SELECT; SELECT_FUNCTION > INPUT_QUERY > SUBMIT_QUERY > AUTH_GATE with no results surface ever rendered → AFTER_TASK_SELECT (04 §3 example → AFTER_TASK_SELECT).
auth_gate_stage.AT_ENDPOINT: the endpoint surface was rendered WITHOUT auth and the gate is hit when its content is accessed (e.g. F5 route list rendered, time/price behind login on SELECT_RESULT).
auth_gate_stage.UNDETERMINED: A T-A-V3-STEP1-007 R13: path not observed to an evidence-bearing terminal.
auth_gate_stage.walker_check: walk_fixture.py derives the stage from task_flow_sequence with this positional rule (AT_ENDPOINT additionally requires the fixture flag endpoint_surface_rendered_before_gate=true) and requires equality with the expected value on every fixture.

derivation_rules_preregistered.endpoint_status: REACHED iff the family endpoint contract is satisfied in the final state; AUTH_GATE iff final token is AUTH_GATE; nothing else exercised here. A T-A-V3-STEP1-011 P-17: endpoint_status and action_token are separate layers (always field-qualified); a task surface that is absent is endpoint_status=PUBLIC_WEB_UNOBSERVABLE × terminal_reason=TASK_SURFACE_ABSENT ('we know it is absent'), endpoint_status=ABSTAIN is 'we do not know'.
derivation_rules_preregistered.generic_login_rule: presence of a login control/link anywhere on the page never produces AUTH_GATE; only a gate that the frozen task path enters counts (00 §6, 03 §7). Fixture 4 is the negative control.
derivation_rules_preregistered.lossless: runner's fact_flow_step rows, ordered by step_index, restricted to token-bearing rows, must equal lossless_check as (state_before,data-c-action,state_after) triples with state = body[data-c-state]; url_before/url_after must differ exactly where the fixture changes location.hash (every recorded step).
derivation_rules_preregistered.fixture_input_mode: Δ8-R5 / STEP1-006 'how_to_decide': recorded per conditional token as observed on the control the service offered: <select> or role=listbox/combobox → DROPDOWN; input[type=date|month|time] or a calendar/picker widget (role=dialog|grid opened by the control) → PICKER/CALENDAR; a map drag → MAP_PAN; input[type=text|search|tel|number] typed → FREE_TEXT; several means on one token → MIXED (then the means actually used decides); anything else → OTHER. walk_fixture.py observes the mode from the DOM of the control it drives and requires equality with the expected mode; depth_conditional_tokens is recorded per fixture with index/token/fixture_input_mode/decision/basis (STEP1-006 'record').
derivation_rules_preregistered.conditional_pairs: Positive-control pairs: two fixtures identical except for the input means of one CONDITIONAL token must differ in activation_depth by exactly 1 and be equal in flow_step_count and in task_flow_sequence — checked by walk_fixture.py after the walk (a runner ignoring fixture_input_mode reports equal depths and fails the pair).

occluded_but_hittable.rationale: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-05 discriminator: the F3 entry control is ~84% covered by two blocking sticky overlays (top banner + event ribbon) but its centre lies in a 9px slit and is hit-testable, so s0_task_control_visible=true while task_control_occlusion≈0.84 — the two fields are independent and no occlusion threshold exists (a runner applying occlusion<0.5 reports visible=false and fails). Neither overlay is required for the task (blocking proof: a click at the centre reaches the endpoint with both present) → dismiss_required_for_task=false, forced_dismissal_count=0. Design note: a single rectangle that leaves the centre exposed covers ≤50% of the control, and a pointer-events:none banner yields hit-test occlusion 0.0, so two blocking overlays are used; hit-test (9x9 grid) 68/81=0.840, geometric union 0.832, both pre-computed from the CSS before the run.

s0_path_entry_control.note: in viewport, centre hit-testable through the slit, ~84% of the 9x9 grid points land on an overlay

blocking_proof.why: the centre click reaches the endpoint with both overlays present, so neither is a forced dismissal (GAP-05: visible ⟂ occlusion)

unoccluded_but_offscreen.rationale: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-05 companion of occluded_but_hittable (A's second example: '0 % occluded but off-viewport → not visible'): no overlay exists and nothing ever covers the F3 entry control (hit-test occlusion 0.0 wherever it is observed), but the control is laid out at y≈928px, below the 844px fold, and no scroll is performed at S0 → s0_task_control_visible=false. The two fields are independent in this direction too: a runner that infers visible=true from occlusion 0.0 / no overlay / DOM presence / the same-label trap text fails. S0 numerics follow the GAP-04 null convention (task_control_occlusion_s0=null because the control is not observed at S0, never 0.0); the 0.0 occlusion is recorded at the state where the control is observed (S1 after one scroll step, task_control_occlusion_all_steps=0.0, walker step occlusion 0.00). first_visible_scroll_state=S1 for any scroll step in [120,844] px (GAP-02). Single-token F3 path so the visible/occlusion question is isolated from depth.

GAP-05: s0_task_control_visible=false is an S0 fact; occlusion at S1 is 0.0.
